reviewItem.question: Does "The previously deprecated `metallb-bgp` flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr` have been removed" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cilium|name=metallb-bgp (removed)?

proposed.statement: Cilium 1.17 removes the previously deprecated metallb-bgp flags bgp-config-path, bgp-announce-lb-ip and bgp-announce-pod-cidr; users are now required to use the Cilium BGP control plane for BGP advertisements.
